title: 1972 AHSME Problem 26
statement: In the circle shown, \(M\) is the midpoint of arc \(\widehat{CAB},\) and segment \(MP\) is perpendicular to chord \(AB\) at \(P.\) If the measure of chord \(AC\) is \(x\) and that of segment \(AP\) is \(x+1,\) then segment \(PB\) has measure equal to:

solutions.text:
Choose \(N\) on arc \(\widehat{MB}\) so that arcs \(\widehat{MN}\) and \(\widehat{CA}\) are equal, and drop \(NQ\perp AB.\) Then \(MN=AC=x.\) The remaining equal arcs \(\widehat{AM}\) and \(\widehat{NB}\) give equal corresponding chord projections, so \(QB=AP=x+1.\) Also \(MNPQ\) is a rectangle, hence \(PQ=MN=x.\) Therefore \[ \begin{aligned} PB&=PQ+QB\\ &=x+(x+1)\\ &=2x+1. \end{aligned} \]

Therefore, the correct answer is E.
hints: Copy arc \(\widehat{CA}\) to an arc \(\widehat{MN}\) ending at a new point \(N\) between \(M\) and \(B\)
Drop \(NQ\perp AB\); use equal arcs to identify a rectangle and equal horizontal end segments
